title: Sam68 Exacerbates Pathologic Cardiac Hypertrophy by Suppressing Cardiomyocyte Glucose Oxidation.
authors: An, Junqing; Han, Chaoshan; Jiang, Ying; Shi, Jiawei; Li, Huadong; Wang, Chenqi; Huang, Jianrong; Xu, Shiyue; Ni, Jie; Cao, Yangpo; Feng, Yuliang; Lyu, Qing; Dong, Nianguo; Qin, Gangjian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究RNA结合蛋白Sam68在病理性心肌肥大中通过Src-STAT3-PDK4通路抑制葡萄糖氧化，属于心脏代谢与信号转导研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Metabolic remodeling, marked by maladaptive shifts in substrate use and energy production, is a hallmark of pathologic cardiac hypertrophy. Yet the mechanisms linking stress signaling to impaired myocardial glucose oxidation remain incompletely defined. Sam68 (Src-associated in mitosis, 68 kDa; also known as KHDRBS1 [KH domain-containing, RNA-binding, signal transduction-associated protein 1]), a STAR (signal transduction and activation of RNA) family RNA-binding protein, has not previously been implicated in cardiac metabolic control. METHODS: SAM68 expression was examined in failing human hearts and transcriptomic data sets. Cardiomyocyte-specific Sam68 knockout mice (Sam68cKO) and AAV9 (adeno-associated virus serotype 9)-cTnT (cardiac troponin T)-mediated cardiomyocyte Sam68 overexpression (Sam68OE) were studied in transverse aortic constriction and angiotensin II models. Mechanistic studies included RNA sequencing, targeted metabolomics, in vivo [U-(13)C]-glucose tracing, coimmunoprecipitation, and protein-protein docking. Therapeutic relevance was tested with a PDK4 (pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase 4) inhibitor and the Sam68-Src interface blocker YB-0158, including pharmacokinetics, target engagement, and validation in Sam68cKO mice. RESULTS: Sam68 was increased in failing human cardiomyocytes and in murine hypertrophic hearts. Sam68cKO markedly attenuated angiotensin II- and transverse aortic constriction-induced hypertrophy, whereas Sam68OE aggravated remodeling and dysfunction. In vivo [U-(13)C]-glucose flux analysis showed that transverse aortic constriction caused sustained uncoupling of glycolysis from glucose oxidation, with increased glycolytic labeling but reduced (13)C incorporation into tricarboxylic acid cycle intermediates at 3 days and 4 weeks. Sam68 deletion restored glucose-derived carbon entry into the tricarboxylic acid cycle, enhanced PDH (pyruvate dehydrogenase)-dependent M+2 labeling, and improved oxidative-anaplerotic balance during pressure overload. Mechanistically, Sam68 served as a stress-activated scaffold that promoted Src-dependent STAT3 (signal transducer and activator of transcription 3) Tyr705 phosphorylation, nuclear accumulation, and transcriptional induction of PDK4, leading to PDH Ser293 phosphorylation and suppression of PDH activity. The PDK4 inhibitor blunted Sam68OE-driven remodeling while preserving PDH activity and mitochondrial respiratory programs. YB-0158 achieved cardiac exposure, disrupted Sam68-Src engagement in vivo, suppressed STAT3-PDK4-PDH signaling, and improved transverse aortic constriction remodeling; these effects were lost in Sam68cKO mice, supporting on-target dependence. In failing human hearts, the Src-SAM68-STAT3-PDK4 axis was activated, and SAM68 abundance increased in parallel with PDK4 and reduced left ventricular ejection fraction. CONCLUSIONS: Sam68 is a stress-activated cardiomyocyte scaffold that drives pathologic hypertrophy through a Src-STAT3-PDK4 program that inhibits PDH and suppresses glucose oxidation. Genetic or pharmacologic disruption of this axis restores PDH-dependent pyruvate oxidation and limits pressure-overload remodeling, identifying Sam68 as a druggable metabolic control node in heart failure.
abstract_zh: 背景：代谢重塑以底物利用和能量产生的适应不良性转变为特征，是病理性心脏肥大的标志。然而，将应激信号与心肌葡萄糖氧化受损联系起来的机制仍未完全阐明。Sam68（Src相关有丝分裂蛋白，68 kDa；又称KHDRBS1 [含KH结构域的RNA结合信号转导相关蛋白1]），一种STAR（RNA信号转导与激活）家族RNA结合蛋白，此前未被涉及心脏代谢调控。方法：检测了衰竭人类心脏和转录组数据集中的SAM68表达。在横向主动脉缩窄和血管紧张素II模型中，研究了心肌细胞特异性Sam68敲除小鼠（Sam68cKO）和AAV9（腺相关病毒血清型9）-cTnT（心肌肌钙蛋白T）介导的心肌细胞Sam68过表达（Sam68OE）。机制研究包括RNA测序、靶向代谢组学、体内[U-(13)C]-葡萄糖示踪、免疫共沉淀和蛋白质-蛋白质对接。治疗相关性通过PDK4（丙酮酸脱氢酶激酶4）抑制剂和Sam68-Src界面阻断剂YB-0158进行测试，包括药代动力学、靶点结合以及在Sam68cKO小鼠中的验证。结果：Sam68在衰竭人类心肌细胞和小鼠肥大心脏中表达增加。Sam68cKO显著减弱了血管紧张素II和横向主动脉缩窄诱导的肥大，而Sam68OE则加重了重塑和功能障碍。体内[U-(13)C]-葡萄糖通量分析显示，横向主动脉缩窄导致糖酵解与葡萄糖氧化的持续解偶联，在3天和4周时糖酵解标记增加，但三羧酸循环中间体的(13)C掺入减少。Sam68缺失恢复了葡萄糖来源碳进入三羧酸循环，增强了PDH（丙酮酸脱氢酶）依赖的M+2标记，并在压力超负荷期间改善了氧化-回补平衡。机制上，Sam68作为应激激活的支架，促进Src依赖的STAT3（信号转导与转录激活因子3）Tyr705磷酸化、核积累以及PDK4的转录诱导，导致PDH Ser293磷酸化和PDH活性抑制。PDK4抑制剂减弱了Sam68OE驱动的重塑，同时保留PDH活性和线粒体呼吸程序。YB-0158实现了心脏暴露，在体内破坏Sam68-Src结合，抑制STAT3-PDK4-PDH信号，并改善横向主动脉缩窄重塑；这些效应在Sam68cKO小鼠中消失，支持靶点依赖性。在衰竭人类心脏中，Src-SAM68-STAT3-PDK4轴被激活，SAM68丰度与PDK4平行增加，并与左心室射血分数降低相关。结论：Sam68是一种应激激活的心肌细胞支架，通过抑制PDH和葡萄糖氧化的Src-STAT3-PDK4程序驱动病理性肥大。遗传或药理学破坏该轴可恢复PDH依赖的丙酮酸氧化并限制压力超负荷重塑，将Sam68确定为心力衰竭中可药物干预的代谢调控节点。
